page_title: Customer Slack Desk for B2B SaaS
meta_description: Done-for-you triage and SLA management for shared customer Slack or Teams channels, without dragging founders and engineers into constant chat firefighting.
for_whom: For B2B SaaS, AI, infra, and developer-tool teams running shared customer Slack or Teams channels
hero_headline: Run customer Slack channels without founder ping-pong
hero_subheadline: We triage shared customer channels, route issues to the right owner, maintain follow-up SLAs, and send a weekly risk + expansion summary.
secondary_cta_text: Get a redacted weekly summary sample
credibility_line: Least-privilege access. Named escalation paths. You approve channel norms and escalation rules upfront.
pain_paragraph: Shared customer Slack or Teams channels start as a premium experience, then quietly turn into an unowned queue of bugs, onboarding asks, random questions, and churn signals. Engineers get dragged into reactive support, follow-ups slip, and nobody has a clean view of what is urgent, blocked, or growing into renewal risk.
before: Customer messages sit in Slack until the right person happens to notice
Founders and engineers get pulled into ad hoc support all day
Nobody knows which threads are blocked, urgent, or renewal-sensitive
Important asks get answered inconsistently or lost in the scrollback
after: Every thread is triaged, tagged, and assigned to the right owner
Customers get faster, cleaner follow-up without overpromising
Leadership gets a weekly blocker, churn-risk, and expansion-signal summary
Shared channels feel high-touch without consuming senior people all day
offer_summary: Customer Slack Desk is a done-for-you customer-channel operations layer: we monitor shared Slack or Teams channels, triage each thread, route it to the right internal owner, keep follow-ups moving, and surface the patterns that matter for renewals and expansion.
included: Monitoring and triage for up to 10 shared customer channels
Thread tagging by issue type, urgency, and account risk
Escalation matrix for support, onboarding, bugs, and commercial asks
Weekly summary with blockers, repeated asks, churn risks, and upsell signals
One-time channel audit and triage playbook setup
excluded: Hands-on technical troubleshooting beyond triage and routing
Writing product fixes or implementing customer requests
Unlimited channels, unlimited stakeholders, or custom reporting outside plan scope
process: 15-minute fit call to confirm channel volume, ICP, SLA expectations, and internal owners
Set up channel rules, escalation paths, tag taxonomy, and weekly summary format
Run daily triage: tag threads, route requests, chase follow-ups, and keep the queue clean
Send a weekly summary with open blockers, churn risks, repeated asks, and expansion signals
Refine the playbook as patterns emerge so more of the work can be delegated or automated
pricing_headline: Starter: $1,500/mo for up to 5 shared channels
pricing_details: Includes weekday triage, SLA follow-up tracking, weekly summary, and one channel-audit setup. Growth plan: $2,500/mo for up to 10 shared channels and deeper reporting. Pilot offer: $500 for a 1-week channel audit + managed trial, credited toward month 1.
guarantee_line: If we cannot deliver a usable triage workflow and first weekly summary within 7 days of kickoff, we keep working free until we do.

faq.q: How do you access our customer channels safely?
faq.a: Least-privilege access only. We join only the channels you assign, follow your internal escalation rules, and keep exported notes limited to the weekly summary and approved working docs.

faq.q: What needs to be true before onboarding works?
faq.a: You need named internal owners for support, product/engineering, and commercial escalations, plus a clear definition of what we can answer directly versus what must be routed.

faq.q: Do you respond directly to customers?
faq.a: Yes, if you want that model. We can either triage silently behind the scenes or operate as the first response layer using approved tone, scope, and escalation rules.

faq.q: How long do you retain customer-channel data?
faq.a: Only as long as needed for active work and agreed reporting. We recommend a short retention window, store summaries rather than full exports whenever possible, and delete working artifacts on request.

faq.q: Is this a fit if we need full support coverage?
faq.a: Usually no. This works best when you need ownership, triage, routing, and visibility in shared channels—not a 24/7 outsourced support team or deep technical implementation bench.

trust_basics_line: Instrumentation from day 1: pageview, CTA click, form submit, booked call. Optional NDA. Clear scope limits. No production access required.
